reference.usage: Style reference only; materialized with Library helper; pixels viewed locally; unchanged.

prompts.habitat:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: reusable transparent pixel-art game habitat sprite.
Input image: approved lunar-base art-direction board, STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target.
Primary request: create ONE standalone lunar habitat matching the reference EXACTLY in art direction and pixel scale. Detailed white/slate modular habitat with large warmly glowing amber windows containing tiny furniture and cyan displays, navy trim, rooftop solar panels, dish, antenna, amber warning lamps and one airlock ramp pointing lower-right. Three-quarter elevated game perspective: front and right faces visible, horizontal world axis right, ground depth up-right. Softly shaded retro pixel art, carefully clustered square pixels, beautiful fine architectural detail, dark blue edges. Habitat is approximately 400 game pixels wide and 235 game pixels tall. Compose it centered filling most of a 1536x1024 transparent canvas with comfortable margins.
Constraints: ONE habitat only. NO astronauts or people anywhere. NO lunar ground or landscape, no background, no stars or Earth, no title, no labels, no detached props, no baked ground shadow. Genuine transparent background. Preserve the reference's friendly miniature world feel, NOT flat vector, NOT crude shapes, NOT photorealistic. Original reference remains unchanged.
prompts.console:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent pixel-art game console prop, for the same lunar base as the supplied style reference. Create a standalone detailed white/slate/navy outdoor computer console with bright cyan monitor displaying tiny schematic pixels, angled keyboard shelf, warm amber indicator lamps, a small connected white storage box to its right. Front and right faces visible in same three-quarter elevated perspective as board. About 66x70 game pixels, rendered larger as carefully clustered crisp square pixel art matching approved reference EXACTLY: softly shaded detailed materials, thick dark navy edges, white highlights. Centered on transparent 1024x1024 canvas, generous clear margins.
No astronaut or people, no ground, no shadow, no background, no landscape, no text, no title. Keep keyboard approachable from lower-left. Genuine alpha transparency. Style reference is guidance only, do not edit original.
prompts.astronaut:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent animation sprite atlas for a web pixel-art lunar-base game. Input image is exact approved art-direction reference only. Create a sprite sheet of ONE consistent tiny chunky cartoon astronaut with round oversized white helmet, very dark navy visor with cyan glint, white shaded suit, slate shadows, teal suit trim and small white backpack. EXACTLY match the characters in lower-left reference board, same proportions and soft detailed clustered pixel art, elevated three-quarter view. Genuine transparent background.
Layout MUST be regular grid: 6 equal columns by 3 equal rows, 1536x1024 output, no visible lines, no labels, no text. Each of 18 cells has one complete astronaut, centered on its vertical axis with BOTH boot soles aligned to the SAME foot baseline within every cell. Identical scale, helmet and body across all cells. Transparent generous cell gaps. Character is about 55% cell width and 75% cell height.
Row 1: facing right, SIX consecutive walking frames: left contact, left passing, left lift, right contact, right passing, right lift. Both legs visibly articulate as a continuous convincing walk, hands swing, slight 1-pixel body bounce only. Never duplicate still pose for all frames.
Row 2: facing front/right three-quarter, SIX subtle standing idle frames, hand relaxed, small breathing and visor glint, identical planted feet.
Row 3: facing right, SIX working typing frames: arms reaching ahead at waist-height, hands alternately typing into empty transparent space, no console drawn, feet planted at same baseline. White backpack visible. 
Constraints: no console or props, no floor, no shadow, no scenery, no black or checkerboard background, no extra astronauts per cell. Every full figure separated, no touching neighbors. Crisp pixel clusters, not vector, no blur. Reference remains unchanged.
prompts.terrain:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: landscape background for a small 2D lunar-base game, 1536x1024.
Input image is approved EXACT art-direction reference. Generate ONLY the lunar terrain and distant skyline in precisely the same polished retro pixel-art style and palette: lavender-grey dusty regolith, detailed scattered small slate stones, subtle crater rims, far rugged purple-grey mountains, dark midnight starfield and a blue Earth low above the horizon toward upper-right. Scene in same elevated three-quarter perspective as reference, crisp clustered pixels and softly shaded fine details.
Composition: horizon at approximately 22% from top. Wide clear open relatively level central lunar ground from x=15% to 85% and y=35% to 88% for placing a separate habitat and walking astronauts. Rockier edges at bottom corners, mountains far away. Directional cool ambient light from upper-left. Lighter lavender dusty ground, dark blue shadows. Same charm and rich atmosphere as reference.
ABSOLUTELY NO buildings, habitats, astronauts, people, consoles, vehicles, solar panels, containers, cables, paths, props, text, titles, UI, logos, watermark. Do not reuse baked reference objects. This is a NEW clean background, original remains unchanged.
